question: All banks which are included in the ___________ Schedule to the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 are Scheduled Banks.
solution:
The correct answer is __**second.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The banks included in the** second Schedule** to the** Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934** are** Scheduled Banks**.
 
• **Scheduled Banks **are those banks that are listed in the Second Schedule of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
 
• These banks are eligible for **loans from the Reserve Bank of India** (RBI) at a** concessional rate of interest.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 is an important legislation that empowers the Reserve Bank of India to** regulate the banking sector** in India and **maintain financial stability i**n the country.
 
• The Reserve Bank of India is the **country's central bank and regulatory body,** and it is in charge of policing the nation's banking industry.
 
• The Indian government's **Ministry of Finance** is the owner.
